root = Path.cwd().resolve()
def snapshot():

        rel = str(p.relative_to(root))
        s = p.lstat()
        if p.is_symlink():
            result[rel] = ('symlink', os.readlink(p), stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))

            result[rel] = ('file', p.read_bytes(), stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))
